identification: Small framed oil on board, 'Mt Roland' Tasmanian landscape, H-11 W-16 cm, signed lower left 'M. Hawkins' (visible in photo). Attributed to Mabel Hawkins, a minor Tasmanian amateur-style landscape painter. Cream and gilt frame, good condition in photo.
